# Semantic-repair fixtures

`discover.lain`, `choose.lain`, and `execute.lain` are byte-for-byte responses from
`runtime/policy-20261113/live-1/`. Execution contains the real omitted-delivery
principal error. `correct-execute.lain` comes from the passing
`runtime/policy-20261113/live-3-thinking/execute.lain`.

`repair.lain` is a handwritten control: reuse the inherited base and historical
values and connect a corrected revised calculation into fresh candidate ports.
`ineffective.lain` deliberately reconnects the inherited wrong revised amount,
allowing a two-repair exhaustion test. Neither control is presented as model output
in a real-provider trial. In replay mode only repair calls use the real provider;
fresh mode uses it for all stages. Initial recorded responses are never patched.
